title: Evaporation
learningObjective: Students will explain how water evaporates when heated by the sun

procedure.instruction: Watch the animation 'Water Disappears into the Air' showing evaporation.
scaffoldingSupports: Point out: The sun heats the water
Point out: Water turns into tiny droplets we can't see (water vapor)

procedure.instruction: Use the slider to add heat to a puddle and watch what happens.
scaffoldingSupports: Ask: 'What happens when we add more heat?'
Confirm: 'The water disappears into the air as water vapor'

procedure.instruction: Draw a picture showing the sun heating up a puddle. Label the sun and the puddle.
scaffoldingSupports: Provide sentence frame: 'The sun heats the ___'
Remind: Show steam/vapor rising from the puddle

procedure.instruction: Learn vocabulary: evaporation, heat, sun energy, water vapor.
scaffoldingSupports: Define evaporation: When liquid water turns into gas
Connect to real life: Puddles after rain disappear

multimediaResources.caption: Watch water evaporate as the sun heats it
multimediaResources.accessibilityDescription: Animation showing sunlight heating a puddle, with water molecules rising as vapor

multimediaResources.caption: Add heat to see water evaporate
multimediaResources.accessibilityDescription: Interactive slider that adds heat/sunlight to a puddle, showing evaporation

exitTicket.questionText: Where does puddle water go? Draw and label your answer.
exitTicket.correctAnswer: The water evaporates into the air as water vapor
exitTicket.explanation: When the sun heats the puddle, the water turns into water vapor (a gas) and goes into the air. This is called evaporation!
